args.title: Fix truncation of '(copy)' suffix in duplication endpoint
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Change the truncation logic to ensure the '(copy)' suffix is always fully appended to the new name when duplicating a report. This requires truncating the original name first before appending the suffix, preventing the suffix from being cut off near the length limit.

args.title: Fix date handling in export filename generation
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change formatExportFilename function to convert 'at' to local date in the intended timezone before formatting the export filename. This avoids using UTC date which causes filename to correspond to a next UTC day in some time zones like Los Angeles.
